thread:
elena: Quick sync on the BlueHarbor POC — we need a prompt stocktake + baseline prompts, a pricing sensitivity check for a 6-week pilot, and any security/legal blockers. Can we align on success criteria and deliverables? @omar @rachel

omar: On it. Quick clarifying Q: are they expecting Private (VPC/on-prem) or hosted? Their RFP mentioned 'private deployment' a few times which impacts pricing and timeline. @rachel do we have contract signals?

rachel: LOI signed but SOW not finalized. They require EU data residency, SOC2 evidence, and Okta SSO. Timeline they want is ~6 weeks for pilot. Proposed success criteria from buyer side: functional accuracy, acceptable latency, and cost targets. I'll tighten once I hear back.

devon: For the prompt inventory I sketched a minimal baseline mapping (user prompt -> system instruction -> eval type). Example snippets:
```
1) Summarize customer email -> "Condense to 3 bullet highlights" -> human-rated relevance (3-point scale)
2) Extract invoice fields -> "Return JSON: {vendor,amount,date}" -> strict schema match (automated)
3) Answer product compliance question -> "Cite sources when unsure" -> citation precision
```
We should include edge cases (PII redaction), adversarial prompts, and hallucination probes. Aim for 8-12 canonical prompts + 20 adversarial cases.

elena: Good start. Please add 2 explicit PII redaction prompts and 2 hallucination stress tests. Also add expected output format for each (free text, JSON, boolean, list).

omar: Model family tradeoffs: smaller quantized 13B will be cheaper but may fail harder on long-context extraction. Llama2/70B or equivalent gives higher accuracy but increases cost and infra needs. @pricing-bot can you give rough delta for a 10M-token pilot?

pricing-bot: Hosted 13B quantized (v1) estimate for 10M tokens: ~$1,200. Hosted 70B family estimate: ~$8,400. Dedicated (VPC) adds a reserve + infra: base reserved capacity ~ $6k/mo + token compute ~ $3,000 for pilot, plus SRE hours if custom routing required. These are preliminary; will produce a concise table once scope locked.

rachel: Security items: buyer will submit security questionnaire. @security-bot: can we answer within 48 hrs? Also they ask for KMS options and audit logs.

security-bot: We can produce draft questionnaire responses in 48 hours. KMS/bring-your-own-key available for Dedicated/Private; hosted uses Redwood-managed keys by default but we offer customer-managed keys in Dedicated with HSM-backed options. Audit logs and access logs available; will need to confirm retention window and export format with the customer.

devon: Engineering blockers to call out: 1) Data residency — for EU we should run inference in EU region or Private. 2) Network: VPC peering requires their ASN and subnets, plus firewall exceptions for our control plane. 3) Eval harness: we need ~500 labeled examples across use cases for reliable stats. 4) For JSON extraction prompts we must include schema tests and tolerance rules for date formats.

elena: Draft success criteria proposal (for alignment):
- Functional correctness: weighted accuracy >= 85% on the agreed eval set (schema matches + human ratings where applicable)
- Latency: p95 < 600ms hosted / p95 < 400ms on Dedicated in their region
- Cost: compute cost per 1k tokens <= buyer threshold (TBD), pilot estimate to be shared
- Security: no critical open items in the security questionnaire; KMS solution agreed
- Ops: deployment runbook + handoff docs delivered at pilot close

omar: Proposed pilot timeline (6 weeks):
- Week0: kickoff + access requests
- Week1: prompt inventory finalization + eval set ingestion
- Week2: baseline runs (2-3 models) + metrics dashboard
- Week3: tuning (batching, quantization, routing) + regen prompts for fail cases
- Week4: iterate with buyer feedback + SLA checks
- Week5: user acceptance + security review
- Week6: final handoff, docs, and optional extended trial

rachel: I'll coordinate buyer communication and own deliverable checklist: prompt inventory CSV, eval harness link, infra checklist (subnets/ASN), security questionnaire answers, and pricing estimate. Uploading to deal repo and sharing access later today.

devon: I'll push the eval harness template by EOD (automated scoring + human review flags). Please ensure each prompt has at least 2 negative/edge examples and 3 positive examples.

elena: Action items assigned: Omar -> model options + perf tradeoffs, Devon -> eval harness + prompt template, Rachel -> buyer coordination + security questionnaire, Pricing-bot -> consolidated price table for hosted vs dedicated, Security-bot -> draft security answers in 48 hrs. We'll reconvene Fri 10am PT. Ping this thread for blockers.

omar: :thumbsup:

rachel: noted, I'll add timeline to calendar invite and share with procurement.

devon: added TODOs to engineering board.

elena: Thanks all — if anything urgent before Fri, reply here and @ the relevant owner.
